content: This means focusing on tenders where its technological differentiation is a specified requirement and investing heavily in building the right local partnerships to navigate the procedural and political complexities. The goal is not to win every tender, but to win the right ones that will serve as foundational pillars for growth in the region. The fear is that the nuance of "appropriate and reasonable" will be lost, and procurement will be driven by the cheapest available option that satisfies a superficial audit. A presence here is essential for showcasing YAL.ai's value proposition to government CIOs and procurement officials. Phase three would be a deliberate and strategic entry into the public sector market, pursued in conjunction with a highly-rated B-BBEE partner to compete for major tenders. This entire process must be supported by a continuous and visible marketing presence at key industry events and a sales organization that is deeply trained not just on the product's features, but on the art of overcoming the specific commercial, privacy, and technical objections prevalent in the South African market.
